scope.note: Derived reading tables; source artifacts remain authoritative. Fractions use 0..1, not percent.

definitions.request_mean: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-request values
definitions.threshold_sensitivity: predicted_drop_fraction before protected-window override; not final mask or accuracy
definitions.block_fragmentation: cold keep-any padded unused slots / cold allocated slots; request mean
definitions.layout_compression: total logical KV slots / (regular hot slots + page-rounded cold slots); excludes metadata bytes
definitions.read_proxy: layout slots * 512 B + cold page count * 16 B; one full read proxy, not measured HBM
definitions.head_bucket_fragmentation: (rounded cold allocated slots - cold retained slots) / rounded cold allocated slots; request mean; compression includes regular hot storage
definitions.generation_metrics: qa_f1 and whitespace-token ROUGE-L screening, not official LongBench metrics

v1_sampling.known_limit: Category and length buckets are balanced, but task coverage is not; qasper contributes 5/6 retrieval requests and qmsum contributes none.

v2_sampling.known_limit: Task availability remains unequal in some category/length buckets; bucket_report records each gap.

threshold_sensitivity.aggregation: request mean predicted fraction before window protection
